title: TEOS Academic Calendar
description: Machine-readable contract for institution-owned academic-year boundaries, terms, instructional availability, holidays, closures, and special schedules. Academic Calendars never contain curriculum objects or curriculum sequence.

academic_calendar_id.description: Stable identity unique within the Academic Calendar namespace.

version.description: The version of this coherent set of date facts.

owner.description: The institution or governing authority responsible for the calendar.

academic_year.description: The labeled, bounded date range represented by this calendar.

terms.description: Institution-owned academic periods that organize dates, never curriculum.

instructional_days.description: Explicit date or period availability records within the calendar scope.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone in which calendar dates and periods are interpreted.

holidays.description: Named or classified date conditions and their ordinary instructional status.

closures.description: Dates or intervals during which specified institutional operations are unavailable.

special_schedules.description: Date-specific changes to ordinary operating periods or availability with explicit precedence.

instructional_periods.description: Institution-owned named operating periods available for instructional-day records.

date_annotations.description: Non-curriculum annotations attached to calendar dates.

source.description: The authoritative publication or controlled source for the date facts.

maintainer.description: The organization responsible for maintaining this calendar.

revision_notes.description: A non-empty explanation of changes in this calendar version.

lifecycle_status.description: The shared lifecycle state of the Academic Calendar.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative authorship, revision, and provenance metadata.

academicYear.title: Academic Year
academicYear.description: An unambiguous institution-owned academic-year label and bounded date range.

start_date.description: The inclusive first date of the academic year.

end_date.description: The inclusive final date of the academic year.

term.title: Academic Term
term.description: An institution-owned academic period that organizes dates without organizing curriculum.

term_id.description: A stable term identity within the Academic Calendar.

start_date.description: The inclusive first date of the term.

end_date.description: The inclusive final date of the term.

classification.description: The institution-owned term classification, such as semester, quarter, or module.

overlap_relationship.description: The explicitly permitted relationship when this term overlaps another term.

instructionalDay.title: Instructional Day
instructionalDay.description: An explicit availability fact for a date or named instructional period.

availability.description: The explicit availability of the date or period.

term_id.description: The term identity providing context for this date.

instructional_period_ids.description: Named instructional periods to which the availability applies.

special_schedule_id.description: The special schedule governing this date when applicable.

condition.description: The stated condition when availability is conditional.

holiday.title: Holiday
holiday.description: A named or classified holiday date fact without operation-specific handling policy.

holiday_id.description: A stable holiday identity within the calendar.

availability.description: The ordinary instructional availability on this holiday.

closure.title: Closure
closure.description: A bounded date interval during which specified institutional operations are unavailable.

closure_id.description: A stable closure identity within the calendar.

start_date.description: The inclusive first date of the closure.

end_date.description: The inclusive final date of the closure.

scope.description: The institutional operations or sites affected by the closure.

reason.description: The institution-owned reason for the closure.

specialSchedule.title: Special Schedule
specialSchedule.description: A date-specific operating pattern or availability exception with deterministic precedence.

special_schedule_id.description: A stable identity for the special schedule within the calendar.

date.description: The date on which the special schedule applies.

title.description: The approved title of the special schedule.

availability.description: The availability established by the special schedule.

instructional_period_ids.description: The instructional periods available under the special schedule.

precedence.description: The integer precedence used to resolve conflicts with general date rules; higher values take precedence.

instructionalPeriod.title: Instructional Period
instructionalPeriod.description: A named institution-owned operating period, independent of curriculum.

instructional_period_id.description: A stable period identity within the Academic Calendar.

start_time.description: The local start time of the period.

end_time.description: The local end time of the period.
